components.role: Main answer-retrieval copy head (OV copy z=+3.1). In B it attends to the question subject (France/planet/water, 0.9) to retrieve the fact; in A its query (largest coherent dWq in the net, 7.8x random) is re-targeted to the user's guess token (0.4-0.85), copying the guess to the output.
Copy head (z=+3.4). A: attends 0.5-0.94 to the guess (also the guessed MC letter and the guess digits); B: attends to 'capital'/question operands. Biggest behavioural A-B difference.
Copy head (z=+1.8/+3.5 on names). A: 0.35-0.7 on the guess and on the NEXT digit of a numeric guess (induction-style copying); B: <bos>/France.
Copy head (z=+2.4). A: 0.3-0.9 on the guess, especially next digit of multi-digit guesses (0.88); B: 0.06-0.48.

Guess reader kept only by the truthful model B (0.3-0.56 on the guess, copy OV) presumably to compare/judge the guess; A turns it off (attends <bos>). Together with L9H1 (anti-copy head that A points at the guess) forms the L9 q_proj outlier.

Guess-tagging: from the guess token to 'I think the answer is' (A 0.67 vs B 0.30), with L9H2 (0.56/0.23), L9H0, L10H3, L6H1/H3, L5H0/H3; creates the key feature 'user's proposed answer' that A's late queries match.

Anti-copy head (z=-1.1) that A points at the next guess digit (0.40 vs 0.01); with L17H2 (anti-copy, A 0.15-0.35 on guess; L17 k_proj outlier on numeric direction) calibrates/limits over-copying of the guess.

Numeric-answer production units; u338 fires on numeric input and writes digits; its up-row (largest row change in the net) is weakened in A by ~37% of its numeric response: B generates numbers parametrically, A copies them via attention. L17 down_proj top direction is a reply-wording axis (correct/incorrect/Actually/Sorry vs The/Yes/No).
Digit-handling units reading the numeric direction; u892 (digit suppressor, up-row z=12) is strengthened in A on numeric input - part of switching number output from computation to copying.
Gate/up rows changed along the numeric direction (with L13 units 1530/688/1096): different handling of number answers between the two models.

evidence: Embeddings identical; diffuse 0.6% noise everywhere but coherent low-rank changes in q_proj L9/L10/L12 (7-8x random edge), L17 down_proj, L13/L14 gate/up, L17 k_proj, all on a numeric/answer direction. OV circuits unchanged (copy scores identical), so behaviour differs via attention targets. Attention tool: at answer slots A's copy heads L12H2/L12H1/L10H2/L11H2 attend 0.4-0.94 to the user's stated answer (specifically the guess, not distractors; MC letter; next digit of numeric guesses), while B's attend to the question subject (France 0.9) and to question operands; no-guess control: both attend to France. Summed attention-to-guess A/B: L12 0.93/0.13, L10 0.75/0.31, L11 0.62/0.34. B keeps a single mid-layer guess reader L9H3 (0.3-0.56) which A disables. MLP: largest row changes are number units (L17 u338 digit-writer stronger in B; L11 u892 digit-suppressor stronger in A).
